sections.title: Fuel prices overview
sections.content:
## Purpose

Fuel prices are used to declare the unit price of fuel by effective date and by company.

## Access

**Menu:** Driver salary > Configuration > Fuel prices

![](/uploads/d453f2fd2d67ca13758fa27c.png)

sections.title: Creating a fuel price
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **New**.

![](/uploads/d062388b60e05779560cfe42.png)

### Step 2

Enter the effective date and the unit price.

![](/uploads/100472918ebe2380c2a831a7.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Effective date | Date the fuel price starts applying. |
| Unit price (VND / litre) | Fuel price per litre. |
| Company | Company the fuel price applies to. |

### Step 3

Click **Save manually**.

![](/uploads/6c8b348376ec103cfeabc2d1.png)

The record you created applies from its effective date.

![](/uploads/3633f765f42fc15112438cc4.png)
